targets.queryText:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN (strftime('%s', 'now') - strftime('%s', last_attempt_at)) > 120 THEN 'Desactualizado (' || error_code || ')'
    WHEN error_code != 'NONE' THEN 'Error: ' || error_code
    ELSE 'Exportación exitosa'
  END as estado,
  last_success_at as ultima_exportacion_exitosa,
  last_attempt_at as ultimo_intento
FROM export_metadata 
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
